title: Unit Event — On Your Feet — Episode1 Picking Up The Pieces

meta.Event Outline: After learning the truth behind RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD are more determined than ever to surpass that legendary night. The group decide to do what they can for the time being, but Kohane's thoughts linger on her former mentor Taiga.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent work.
Then, on to the next page...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've made my decision...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm done wondering.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND and show you guys what things look like from on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can still feel that fire burning right here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to see what it's like. Beyond Nagi and her team's dream... With An. With everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Now do you understand?
This is what you're all up against.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way Taiga sang really was unbelievable...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so shaken that I couldn't even sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It'll take more than just skill to surpass RAD WEEKEND. But we still need to reach his level... Otherwise, I'm afraid that we won't be able to get anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(How do we overcome this hurdle...?
No, more like an impossibly high wall...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (At the same time, we know we can't let that get us down.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because we've already made our decision...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's do it.
This is our real starting point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're gonna get even better.
We're gonna get Arata, Kotaro and EVER back...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I guess we need to start discussing what to do next.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do we need to do to put on an event that can surpass RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Or rather, what specific steps can we take to make that a reality?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, right...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not just about having the skills to do it. We need to form strong connections not just between us, but also with the crowd. I thought I already understood that, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was her swan song.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Nagi's swan song... She was so loved by the people of this city.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I still have no idea how we're gonna top that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I finally understand why that event was as mind-blowing as it was...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we're standing here today because that night happened. That's as true as it's ever been.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess we just gotta start checking off each box.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because right now, we don't have the skills or the friends we'll need.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll have to face those shortcomings... And think about what steps we can take, like Toya just said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right. We can't stop now.
We need to keep trying things as we go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Starting with...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Bringing everyone back together.
Tono, Mita and all of EVER...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really don't know if what we'll have to say is gonna convince them to try again...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I do know for sure that we need to tell them. About Nagi, about us and about our future.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Agreed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they hear about why RAD WEEKEND happened, then they might just be willing to come back around again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think our chances of success are zero.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
Plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were able to make it this far because we all pushed each other to do better.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also believe that we should try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, that may be easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mean to spoil the moment...
But it's very difficult to regain lost confidence.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was under fairly different circumstances, but I've been down that path. I sort of understand how they feel...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And why it caused them to give up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's tough to find the will to stand back up and fight after you've convinced yourself there's no point...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I also know how that feels...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And the way he sang. He was a monster...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He's right. The way Taiga sang... It scared me...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We couldn't hold our own against that...
And even if we'd managed to, RAD WEEKEND is something even further ahead...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I understand why someone would feel totally helpless after that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really regret what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(If only I could sing better...
If only we could've convinced the others to stay...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, stop...
There's no use crying over spilled milk.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right now, we need to think about what we can do moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I agree that it'll be hard for them to come back.
And... I don't think there's any guarantee that us talking to them will make that happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But at the very least, I wanna tell them about what happened to Aunt Nagi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, after coming this far together, we owe it to them. They have a right to know.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree completely...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And there is a chance of them coming back, no matter how small.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try seeing if they'd be willing to sit down and talk with us somewhere.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That just leaves our giant skill gap.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To be honest, I doubt we're going to find the solution to this problem anytime soon either...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It's not something we can fix here and now, anyway. This is gonna take us a while to figure out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We wouldn't be wondering if we already knew the answer...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If no method is presenting itself, we'll just need to also be thinking about this issue while we continue our practices.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In that case...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our first step should probably be to secure more time together. Would that be a problem for anyone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That time can be used both for longer practices and for us to brainstorm our plans going forward.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also need to do what I can...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to find the time and devote it all to singing!)
bgm_area00003
A few hours later
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, over here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry.
I was asking my teacher about committee business and it ended up taking longer than expected.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, that's totally fine!
But what committee business were you asking about...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I asked to see if there's some way for me to take care of my duties during lunch in order to give myself more time to practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Seems we're all on the same wavelength.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi and I also had discussions along similar lines today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The other hall monitors were happy to hear me out. Same goes for Toya and the library committee. I didn't think it would be this easy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That's great, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As for me, I quit my job.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What?!
Just like that...? I didn't realize you could leave on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Normally, I'd have to put in my two weeks... But my manager's always been rooting for us. He even heard through the grapevine how we lost to Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, after I told him that I wanted to focus on music more, he said, “Go get 'em! I believe in you!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow...
He sounds like such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of work...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I won't be helping out at the cafe for the foreseeable future.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, and your dad's okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yup.
He said, “That's fine. Don't mind us.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I honestly felt a little relieved...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, whenever I see him or any of the locals, all these emotions begin stirring up inside of me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, wait! I'm sorry...!
I don't hate them or anything for what they did!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad and I had a talk afterwards...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, I should probably be getting ready for bed.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Please give me another chance to apologize.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you about Nagi passing away. I'm really sorry...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You better be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, you never let it show at all...
You even said that she might come back someday...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You and the others were all just respecting her last wishes... Fine, I get that. Still...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I had trouble letting go in the end...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
You're right.
Because we'd known each other since we were kids, I didn't want to disrespect her memory.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Also, as an artist, I wanted to see what the next generation she was talking about would be capable of.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
And...
I know this will sound like an excuse...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But as your father, I didn't want you to let go of your dream...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, my actions have caused you a lot of pain...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Which is why I'm genuinely sorry, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't think that I'm gonna forgive you just because you're apologizing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If I knew then that she was gone...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I probably wouldn't have been able to sing the way I wanted...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Which means...
I might've never met Kohane or Akito or Toya.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm not forgiving you guys for what you did.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I don't regret walking this path. Not one bit...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: And thank you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
An and her dad had a chance to talk things out.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, in any case...
We have more time to sing now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can to make the most of every extra minute.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
Oh, actually, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You contacted Tono and everyone the other day, right? Can you tell us what happened after that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I tried contacting them...
But I only heard back from Okazaki.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And he replied, “We need time to settle down and think about what just happened.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, we'll just have to keep trying with Arata and the others as we go! For now, let's focus on practicing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're gonna warm up a little and then head over to MEIKO's place, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I know everyone there's already done quite a bit for us lately, but we should go ask to see if we can borrow her cafe again...
